item.title: Historic ship 'Sava's Titanic' resurfaces in Europe amid drought
item.description: The vessel, which carried wounded soldiers, struck a German mine in April 1945, according to experts.

item.title: Trump unveils new White House helipad, adds personal touch
item.description: President Trump showcased the newly constructed granite helipad at the White House on Wednesday.

item.title: Karmelo Anthony's new trial request hearing scheduled for Thursday
item.description: The hearing follows the removal of the original trial judge from the case by a Collin County court.

item.title: Pilot dies in midair collision between small plane and police helicopter in Pennsylvania
item.description: A small aircraft and a state police helicopter collided in central Pennsylvania, killing the pilot and injuring two troopers.
